## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Vitakkattika* ("The Triad 'Thought-conception, etc.'") constitutes the seventh chapter (Patthana 1.7) of the *Tika-Paṭṭhāna* within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral; Nyanatiloka 2007a; Nyanatiloka 2007b]. As one of the twenty-two triad chapters (*tika*) based on the Abhidhamma matrix, it applies the twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to states distinguished by thought-conception and discursive thinking, following the same structural divisions and subdivisions established in the opening *Kusalattika* [Nyanatiloka 2007a; Nyanatiloka 2007b]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation in one language [SuttaCentral].
In terms of text reuse, DharmaNexus identifies 70,342 matching passages shared across 193 other Pali texts, reflecting the highly repetitive and combinative formulaic system of the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. Its largest Pali-internal reuse partners are other books and chapters within the *Paṭṭhāna*, notably the *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 2.13; 8,599 matches, 911,381 characters), *Kusalattika* (Patthana 1.2; 5,404 matches), *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1; 4,470 matches), *Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 2.10; 4,355 matches), *Hetugocchaka* (Patthana 2.1; 3,459 matches), and *Parittattika* (Patthana 1.13; 3,236 matches) [DharmaNexus]. While SuttaCentral records no curated cross-tradition parallels [SuttaCentral], DharmaNexus detects machine-generated alignments with several Sanskrit and Tibetan Abhidharma and scholastic works, including the Tibetan translation of the *Abhidharmakośaṭīkā* (D4092; 71 matches) and *Abhidharmakoṣabhāṣyaṭīkātattvārtha* (D4421; 31 matches), as well as Ghoṣaka's Sanskrit *Abhidharmāmṛta* (30 matches) and Vasubandhu's *Abhidharmakośabhāṣya* [DharmaNexus].
